_: The current burn's windows (Burn with no switch; docs/hub/usage.md, "Today and this week"), one row per input the rule distinguishes. Every time is LOCAL, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm, read on the clock of the machine running the suite. windows: at now, Today starts at local midnight, This week at the latest Friday 05:00 at or before now, and the answer is right until nextBoundary, the sooner of the next midnight and the next Friday 05:00. records: whether another machine's day record dated <date> counts toward the week starting weekStart -- the week it STARTS in, a record starting at 00:00 on its date, so a record dated the Friday a week starts on is the week before's. summary: the two halves together at one now -- this machine's lines (t is the offset from now's local midnight) split at Friday 05:00 exactly, the other machine's Friday-dated record in Today and not in This week, and this machine's own record never read. Asserted by tkTestToolkit -Burn.

windows.name: a Wednesday: the week began the Friday before
a Thursday night: the next boundary is midnight
Friday 04:59: still last week, and the boundary is at 05:00
Saturday: the week began the day before

rows.why: the Thursday before: the week before's
the Friday the week starts on: its record starts at 00:00, five hours before the week
the Friday the week ends on: its record starts at 00:00, inside the week
